title: 总估价按当前绿色数字整行回读

diagnosis.warm_profile: Five detector calls including discovery took 1.770s; ONNX run self time 1.656s. Postprocessing was not the dominant cost. The small numeric crops are enlarged to minimum side736.
diagnosis.accuracy_finding: Manual review of new local recording crops confirmed one baseline truncated two-digit valuation. Old OCR had detected and accepted only its first digit. The source recordings, labels, timestamps and values remain local.

rejected.trial: Minimum detector side480 only in three numeric callers; no production resize change adopted.
rejected.reason: One previously visible valuation disappeared; another change corrected the independently confirmed truncated value. Mixed accuracy, so whole numeric resizing was rejected. A separate side384 crop also dropped below the unchanged confidence threshold.

implementation: Only when full-frame OCR has no confident numeric candidate for the current valuation label, select its green digit components by colour and label-relative height and submit all selected digits as one line to the existing recognizer. Reuse the existing crop validation, numeric decoding, confidence and original detector fallback. Other numeric fields, full-page detection and engine settings are unchanged.

local_measurement.method: Five manually inspected actual crop inputs, three alternating warmed pairs each, same engine without image-result caching. Local timing excludes capture and full-page label discovery.

wgc.method: Four page entries, first cold then three warm entries separated by a committed operator page; fresh processes in baseline/new/new/baseline order. Actual Windows Graphics Capture, automatic sampler and resource-chip Paint, 1280x800 isolated source window. Paint counted only after HUD evidence from a capture newer than the source repaint, so retained values cannot count as current success.
wgc.baseline_paint_caveat: Two baseline Paint values were wrong; these times are not time-to-correct-result. Complete commit timings include all four entries in both rounds.

validation.regression_red: Final six-test suite against frozen baseline fails six assertions/subtests, including the partial fallback detector reproduction; candidate passes. Raw logs retained locally.
validation.native_window: Original process closed normally and restarted. Native toolbar is responsive and has a rendered WGC frame; frame visually inspected. Windows-MCP desktop crops did not show the toolbar, so unobscured desktop visibility is not claimed.

constraints.rule1: Valuation segmentation consumes the nonempty crop already validated by _number; no duplicate empty-image boundary added. Existing confident full-frame candidates skip both crop and model.
constraints.rule2: _valuation owns colour segmentation and whole-line construction; _number retains shared numeric decoding. No single-call forwarding wrapper.
constraints.rule3: No exception boundary or low-probability defense added, removed or changed. Existing D353 clipped-empty crop handling retained in its existing _number path.

failed_attempts: Initial profiling script name shadowed stdlib profile; renamed before measuring.
First size-trial hook targeted an imported name at the wrong module; corrected before collecting results.
First WGC harness expected a fresh Paint for an unchanged amount; no Paint occurred. Kept failed attempt and measured four distinct entry readings, gated by current HUD evidence.

First desktop crop used logical instead of physical coordinates; corrected DPI coordinates still did not establish unobscured desktop visibility. Exact-window WGC rendering and responsiveness checked.
limits: Small local sample set, not overall accuracy proof; unusual colours, occlusion and other game renderings still need independent coverage.
A confident but wrong full-frame numeric candidate is outside this fallback-only change.
Valuation still waits for whole-page text discovery and is not within500ms; cold model loading and game co-run cost remain open.
Private screenshots, recordings, recognition values and live state were not published.
next: Reuse or recheck current valuation-label evidence before whole-page discovery, with same-frame geometry and source freshness, to reduce the remaining visible wait. Continue collection-count and badge-grade inference analysis without adopting the rejected global numeric resize.
